entries.reason: this is the DESIGNED boundary, declared in promise/rhi/backend_entry.hpp. The dynamic runtime is its only engine-side caller: it builds a shared_ptr<rhi::api_core> around deren_make_api_core(rhi::abi_version, &options, &error) and takes the face as *core_owner. It is what the design predicts the boundary to be, not a regression - and it never leaves while the backend is a DLL.
